propositions: A bug_trends metrics lens must expose five dimensions: close_class distribution by month, detected_by distribution, open-bug age percentiles, caused_by link fan-in per target, and time-to-close percentiles, registered in the standard rebar metrics registry.

Pre-convention bugs lacking close_class (approximately 214 historical records) must be surfaced as an explicit labeled MISSING cohort to prevent silent era-mixing, not dropped or merged with classified bugs.

Flow dimensions (close_class-by-month, time-to-close) filter on close transition timestamp within the context since/until range; stock dimensions (open-bug age, detected_by, caused_by) are point-in-time measures over current store and ignore the range window.
The detected_by dimension must degrade gracefully to unavailable when the field is sparse or absent across all bugs, without affecting other dimension availability.

The lens must handle edge cases: zero bugs return unavailable state per registry convention, and mixed-era stores with both classed and unclassed bugs preserve both cohorts with explicit taxonomy-window labeling.
